conditions.baseline: Current local checkout; isolated synthetic fixture dataset; server/runtime warmed between requests.
conditions.cache_method: one cold navigation in a fresh browser context/cache is followed by three measured warm navigations in the same context; PostgreSQL/PHP/OS were not cold-started.
conditions.source_fingerprint_note: Start and end fingerprints cover app, routes, views, CSS/JS source, and composer.lock.
conditions.run_note: Final seeded baseline; authenticated Laravel cookie renewal was persisted after successful warm responses. No app optimization was applied.
